column1: Social > Sample creator profile > Creator overview (768) [11474-214610]
column5: ★ DOM SIDE BLOCKED BY A DEFECT I MEASURED, not by the dev harness. /:username renders "Profile Not Created - @<handle> hasn't created their social profile yet." for a REAL user with real follower rows. Traced to the source: profileService.getProfileByUsername:434 calls `get_user_public_by_username`, which has EXECUTE granted to `anon` but is NOT SECURITY DEFINER (`prosecdef = false`, probed at the object 2026-08-26), and `anon` holds only REFERENCES+TRIGGER on `public.users` - no SELECT. Running it as `anon` raises `42501: permission denied for table users`; :439 does `if (rpcError || !publicData) return null`, and the page turns that null into "this user has no profile". `authenticated` DOES have SELECT, so a signed-in visitor sees the real page and an anonymous one - anybody following a shared profile link - does not. ESCALATED, NOT FIXED: the fix is either SECURITY DEFINER on that function or a grant, and granting `anon` SELECT on `public.users` is exactly the overexposure this repo has fixed before. Migrations are write-only for this lane and this one is a security decision. Frame boxes: 768x1643 / 375x1633 (Creator overview) and 768x1247 / 375x1258 (Groups tab).
